payload.reason: The evidence provides specific methods for measuring topic quality, particularly through the use of Normalised Pointwise Mutual Information (NPMI) scores and perplexity.

claims.text: Topic quality is measured using Normalised Pointwise Mutual Information (NPMI) scores, where higher scores indicate better topic coherence.
Perplexity is another measure used to evaluate the modeling accuracy of topic models, with lower scores indicating higher accuracy.
Meta information can improve topic quality by enhancing the coherence of topics discovered by models like MetaLDA.
